semantics.exact_rule: References resolve by explicit canonical identity.
semantics.no_fuzzy_rule: Semantic resolution never depends on fuzzy name/path similarity.
semantics.registry_rule: Registries may locate authoritative identities but do not replace their semantics.
semantics.recursive_rule: A reader can recursively follow references across contract boundaries.

invariants.rule: A generic reader can resolve canonical identity, Topic context, references and semantic ownership without filesystem or prose heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: registry result treated as semantic definition
